items.title: Sentios ‘Proof of Spend’ Badges Bring Continuous AI Security Reviews Into Projects
items.body: Bitsec (SN60) launches Sentios badges, allowing projects to publicly verify continuous AI-powered security reviews and build trust with users and investors.

items.body: Apex and Bitstarter partner to help Bittensor teams test incentive mechanisms with real miners, reduce launch costs, and improve projects before launching…

items.title: ‘Talking Targon’ Ep. 01 With Const on eTAO and Subnet Economics
items.body: Talking Targon debuts with Const explaining how eTAO gives subnet owners flexible emissions and could help Targon (SN4) expand computing capacity.

items.title: Backprop Finance Brings Bittensor Alpha Trading to Telegram
items.body: Backprop Finance lets Bittensor traders buy and sell subnet alpha tokens through Telegram, making dTAO trading easier to access.

items.title: Florian Explains Why Decision Models Could Be Much Bigger Than Chatbots
items.body: REAX founder Florian joined Mark Jeffrey to explain why decision models could become a major part of AI software and why Bittensor is well suited to build them.
